newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks fell by 932,000 barrels in the week ending March 19 to 11.76 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said on Thursday.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks fell by a 985,000 barrels to 5.786 million barrels. They comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks rose by 27,000 barrels to 5.207 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
